start.title: The Famine
start.text:
The promised land cracks under drought.
Flocks weaken. Sarah grows thin.

choices.text: Trust God and wait for rain
Curse the dry sky
Turn south to Egypt at once

road_south.title: The Road South
road_south.text:
Egypt promises grain. Sarah walks beside you, silent.
The horizon shimmers.

choices.text: Pray before each step forward
Push on without a word to God

fear_rises.title: A Cold Thought
fear_rises.text:
Egyptians may kill you to take your wife.
Fear coils tight inside your chest.

choices.text: Plot a lie to save yourself
Trust God to guard you both
Turn back to the famine

the_lie.title: The Half-Truth
the_lie.text:
Sarah's eyes find yours. "Say you are my sister."
The words taste like ash.

choices.text: Confess fear and speak truth
Make her agree to the lie

entering_egypt.title: The Gates of Egypt
entering_egypt.text:
The city teems. Eyes follow Sarah everywhere.
Whispers reach the palace.

choices.text: Stay close and shield her
Step away to seem unrelated
Boast of the gifts you'll receive

officials_come.title: Pharaoh's Officials
officials_come.text:
An official arrives. "Pharaoh has heard of her beauty."
His smile is polite. Sharp.

choices.text: Repeat the lie — "My sister"
Speak truth — "She is my wife"

sarah_taken.title: Alone
sarah_taken.text:
They lead Sarah toward the palace.
The tent is suddenly unbearably quiet.

choices.text: Fall to your knees and cry to God
Sit numb and count your losses

gifts_arrive.title: The Price of Silence
gifts_arrive.text:
Sheep, gold, servants — Pharaoh's payment.
Each gift feels like a nail.

choices.text: Accept them, hide the shame
Refuse them and beg God to act
Send them back to Pharaoh

plagues.title: God Strikes
plagues.text:
Sickness sweeps through Pharaoh's house.
No healer can name its cause.

choices.text: Know that God has not forgotten
Fear what God will do to you

confronted.title: The Reckoning
confronted.text:
Pharaoh's voice shakes. "Why did you do this?
Why did you say 'my sister'?"

choices.text: Make excuses for your fear
Bow your head — no defense
Blame the famine for it all

expelled.title: Sent Away
expelled.text:
"Take your wife. Take it all. Go."
Guards walk you to the border.

choices.text: Walk ahead, too ashamed to look
Reach for Sarah's hand in silence

altar.title: The Altar
altar.text:
Back in the promised land, you build stones.
The promise stands — despite you.
